note: Proposed table of round DATA-5 (R257), for Bader to confirm. It names the IM code each neighbourhood of Phase 1 is known by in the file names of the past jobs. The tool reads the area of a plot from its Neighbourhood_ID and Construction_Zone in the Rev 9 DLUS (R256), never from an IM letter, so this table only names files. status is measured when files of that code hold plots and the area key puts them in that neighbourhood, text when only a title or a path names the code, guessed when nothing on this machine names it and the row follows the letter order of the measured rows. conflicts lists the files of the code that hold other neighbourhoods.
